item.title: Alexandra Eala Ousts Jasmine Paolini from 2026 Dubai Tennis Championships in Straight Sets
item.description: Alexandra Eala defeated world No. 8 Jasmine Paolini 6-1, 7-6(5), advancing to the third round in Dubai with her third career Top 10 win. The post Alexandra Eala Ousts Jasmine Paolini from 2026 Dubai Tennis Championships in Straight Sets appeared first on Just Women's Sports.

item.title: Zoi Sadowski-Synnott Claims Silver Medal in Olympic Snowboard Slopestyle Final
item.description: New Zealand snowboarder Zoi Sadowski-Synnott won slopestyle silver at the 2026 Winter Games, earning her fifth career Olympic medal. The post Zoi Sadowski-Synnott Claims Silver Medal in Olympic Snowboard Slopestyle Final appeared first on Just Women's Sports.

item.title: Mikaela Shiffrin Dominates Slalom to Win Olympic Gold, Ends 8-Year Medal Drought
item.description: Mikaela Shiffrin won Olympic slalom gold on Wednesday, ending an eight-year medal drought and becoming the most decorated US alpine skier. The post Mikaela Shiffrin Dominates Slalom to Win Olympic Gold, Ends 8-Year Medal Drought appeared first on Just Women's Sports.

item.title: Team USA’s Alysa Liu Shines, Amber Glenn Stumbles in Olympic Figure Skating Short Results
item.description: Team USA's Alysa Liu finished third in the Olympic figure skating short program, as temmate Amber Glenn dropped to 13th after a costly error. The post Team USA’s Alysa Liu Shines, Amber Glenn Stumbles in Olympic Figure Skating Short Results appeared first on Just Women's Sports.

item.title: Black History Month Spotlight: Figure Skating Icon Mabel Fairbanks
item.description: Pioneering coach and athlete Mabel Fairbanks blazed a path for Black figure skaters — despite never being allowed to compete professionally. The post Black History Month Spotlight: Figure Skating Icon Mabel Fairbanks appeared first on Just Women's Sports.
